purpose: Correct Batch 003 feedback: it had a process, but opened too loudly, felt forced, and did not help the listener enter sleep, meditation, calm, or focus.
hardGates: Reject if the first 20-30 seconds feel like a loud arrival instead of a quiet invitation.
Reject if the noise layer becomes the content identity.
Reject if music and environment feel glued together rather than slowly revealed.
Reject if the result is merely listenable music and not a state-entry soundscape.

candidates.title: Quiet Room Cocoon — Slow Entry
candidates.stateArc: near-silence room -> low shelter appears -> pad warms the space -> small music memory -> everything lowers again
candidates.listeningQuestion: First judge only the first 30 seconds: does it invite you in quietly, or does it still announce itself too loudly?

sources.note: the first layer is room air, not noise
brown support waits until the room is established
pad rises slowly and never becomes a foreground song
the piano appears late as a memory, then leaves

limitations: Quiet-entry arrangement preview; not a final commercial master.
Noise layers are intentionally delayed and low; reject if they still feel like the main content.
Human listening must confirm state entry, softness, fatigue, and replay value before promotion.

candidates.title: Return-to-Sleep Cabin — No-Startle Return
candidates.stateArc: dark room first -> fan-like warmth enters under hearing -> one soft harmonic lift -> stable low room for returning to sleep
candidates.listeningQuestion: Does this feel safe enough for waking at night, when any sudden brightness would make you stop listening?

sources.note: dry room keeps the opening soft and non-scenic
fan warmth replaces obvious white noise
one slow harmonic lift, then it drops behind the room
barely audible low anchor for continuity

limitations: Quiet-entry arrangement preview; not a final commercial master.
Noise layers are intentionally delayed and low; reject if they still feel like the main content.
Human listening must confirm state entry, softness, fatigue, and replay value before promotion.

air is used as exhale texture, not a blanket hiss
warm floor enters only after the room feels settled
one late cue, not repeated bell decoration
